description: This file defines the OrdersController class for handling delivery order operations such as creation, retrieval, listing, and updating order status in an ASP.NET Core Web API application.

classes.name: OrdersController
classes.description: Controller handling CRUD operations for delivery orders including creation, retrieval, listing by user, and status updates.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new delivery order based on the provided request payload.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Retrieves an order by its unique identifier.

methods.name: ListByUser
methods.description: Lists all orders associated with a specific user.

methods.name: UpdateStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of an existing order.
